# Canary — world risk status as_of 2026-11-23T23:42Z · next run ~05:40 UK · stale after 2026-11-24T13:42Z (36h for daily-tier signals) Assessed by an AI model (Anthropic Claude) against published rubrics; attention levels, not forecasts or advice. CC BY 4.0 · https://canary.danleech.com Basis: 27 measured from open data, 9 follow a published figure, 53 are AI judgements from news reports (weigh these with more caution). Known limitations: https://canary.danleech.com/methodology#known-limits
World State 40/100 (Strained) · 13 Alert · 46 Watch · 30 Normal Headline: US shares rebounded on 23 Nov and the VIX fell below 30, easing equity stress to Watch. The US–Iran war, Gulf shipping attacks, the Russia–Ukraine war and DR Congo's Ebola outbreak remain at Alert.
## Situations (7 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, worsening]: Iran vowed on 23 Nov to counter the US blockade of its ports; IRGC says two tankers hit mines east of Hormuz; Iran struck a Bahrain site on 21 Nov. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, eu-gas, chokepoints, freight, uk-energy-cap; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, oil, fertiliser, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, worsening]: Russian strikes on the Kyiv region killed at least 15 on 22–23 Nov; a Russian missile came down in Poland on 20 Nov; Zaporizhzhia is on one power line. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI +2.46 for Aug–Oct; global temperature 1.93°C above pre-industrial on 17 Nov; Sudan's rains the driest in over three decades. → alert: enso, global-temp; watch: drought, co2, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, stable]: ECDC counts 11,504 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,630 deaths to 16 Nov, mostly in DR Congo. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: Army strikes near RSF-held Al Nuhud in West Kordofan in the week to 21 Nov; UN says drones killed over 1,630 civilians in Jan–Oct. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - France: debt stress and protests [WATCH, stable]: French 10-year yield near 4.9% on 19–20 Nov, keeping the Bund spread close to 150bp; protests in France entered a fifth weekend on 14–15 Nov. → watch: sovereign-debt, civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: UK CPI 3.6% in Oct and a December Bank Rate rise priced; a strong dollar and Fed rate-rise bets weigh on gold and shares. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility, gilts; normal: em-stress
## Other Alerts - Cholera & mosquito-borne [cholera-dengue] stable, AI-judged: WHO counts over 3,000 cholera deaths in 2026, nearly nine in ten in Africa; DR Congo, Sudan and Yemen hard hit - UK terrorism threat level [uk-threat-level] stable, AI-judged: UK national terrorism threat level Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 23 Nov
## Changed in last 24h - Exploited vulnerabilities [exploited-vulns]: NORMAL→WATCH — CISA added 11 known-exploited vulnerabilities in the seven days to 23 Nov, reaching the 11-a-week Watch line (2026-11-23T23:42Z) - US equity stress [equity-stress]: ALERT→WATCH — S&P 500 jumped 4.7% on 23 Nov, ending a seven-day slide; VIX eased to 26.6, back below the 30 Alert line (2026-11-23T23:42Z) - FTSE 100 [ftse]: WATCH→NORMAL — FTSE 100 near 10,481 on 23 Nov, 3.9% below its 52-week high after recovering from the 20 Nov low (2026-11-23T17:52Z) - Gold (fear gauge) [gold]: ALERT→WATCH — Gold near $3,620 on 23 Nov, 6.3% lower on the week and 22% lower over three months; weekly fall now inside the 7% line (2026-11-23T05:53Z)
